next.reason: 1985 GR7: 'The execution of the WRITE statement releases a logical record to the operating system.' 2023 §2023:14.9.51.4 GR12: 'The successful execution of a WRITE statement releases a logical record to the operating environment', and §2023:14.9.51.4 GR34 restates the release. 'Successful' only spells out 1985 GR2 ('released by the successful execution') and GR8/GR18 (a failed WRITE does not take place); operating system -> operating environment is wording. Same.
